question: In which year was the 11th Fundamental Duty added to the list of Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2002**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

The 11th Fundamental Duty was added to the Indian Constitution in **2002**.

 
• **Addition of the 11th Fundamental Duty:** The 11th Fundamental Duty was added through the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act of 2002.
 
• **Original List of Fundamental Duties:** The Indian Constitution initially did not contain any Fundamental Duties. These were added later.
 
• **Inclusion of Fundamental Duties:** The Fundamental Duties were incorporated into the Constitution through the 42nd Amendment in 1976.
 
• **Number of Original Fundamental Duties:** Initially, ten Fundamental Duties were added to the Constitution.
 
• **Article 51A:** These duties are listed in Article 51A of the Indian Constitution, which forms a part of Part IVA.
 
• **Significance of Fundamental Duties:** Fundamental Duties are moral obligations of citizens towards the nation.
 
• **Enforceability:** Unlike Fundamental Rights, Fundamental Duties are not directly enforceable by a court of law. However, they serve as a guide to responsible citizenship.
 
• **The 11th Fundamental Duty:** The 11th Fundamental Duty, added in 2002, states: "It shall be the duty of every citizen of India who is a parent or guardian to provide opportunities for education to his child or ward between the age of six and fourteen years." 
 
• **Focus on Education:** This duty emphasizes the importance of education for children in the specified age group.
 
• **Parental Responsibility:** It places a responsibility on parents or guardians to ensure that children receive basic education.
 
• **Connection to Right to Education:** This duty is closely linked to the Right to Education, which was also made a Fundamental Right through the same 86th Amendment.
 
• **Complementary Nature:** Fundamental Rights and Fundamental Duties are complementary to each other. Rights and duties are two sides of the same coin.
 
• **Balanced Approach:** The inclusion of Fundamental Duties aimed to create a balance between the rights and obligations of citizens.
 
• **Importance of Citizen Participation:** Fundamental Duties highlight the role of citizens in contributing to the progress and development of the nation.
 
• **Awareness and Implementation:** Creating awareness about Fundamental Duties is crucial for their effective implementation.
